limitations.note: The rewrite decodes the lights combinationally from the current state instead of restoring the missing clocked stage that makes the light outputs and counter reload sample the same pending light.
The rewrite starts directly in red and replaces the count-3 pipelined transitions with count-1 transitions, changing the reset and startup timing that the reference preserves.
The bench required immediate red on reset and checked the rewrite’s transition schedule, so it validated the new timing rather than detecting the loss of the registered output stage.
